name: Fajar Martha Santosa
bio: Fajar Martha Santosa is a filmmaker based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Working in a wide scope of filmmaking allows him to make films in various forms; fiction, documentary, hybrid, and animation.

credits.title: Red Zone: Dead City
credits.overview: Two weeks after a devastating zombie outbreak destroys their home, a resilient young woman and her band of refugees flee to a neighboring safe zone, only to be hunted by paranoid locals convinced the outsiders are harboring the lethal virus.

credits.title: Before Granny Gets Us
credits.overview: Hestu and Akbar are twin brothers forced to reunite when their grandmother dies on a sacred day (Saturday Wage, the 6th of June at 6 o'clock). credits.title: Pertaruhan 3: The Series
credits.overview: Elzan has been framed. He must prove his innocence before his family suffers the consequences. The victims keep falling, and a secret from the past is uncovered. Who is truly behind all this chaos?

credits.title: Mulih
credits.overview: Lasi work as a maid. One afternoon, her sister calls her to go back to her hometown to visit Lasi’s mother. On her way home, a tragedy happens.

credits.title: 400 Words
credits.overview: An engaged couple having a lunch in a cafeteria, and we follow their conversation as they go into minute detail about what needs to be organized for the upcoming wedding. This is a glimpse into the life of a modern young people struggling with their parents’ cultural legacy.
